description: This file defines the 'Note' entity class for the backend part of a notes application. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mappings, including fields for id, title, content, creation timestamp, and update timestamp, as well as lifecycle callbacks for timestamp management.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note with fields for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with lifecycle methods to set timestamps.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Sets createdAt and updatedAt timestamps before persisting the entity.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Updates the updatedAt timestamp before updating the entity.
